scope: read-only path-and-content equivalence for previously measured core, deep, performance, storage, and dependency-audit inputs

coreInputEquivalence.oracle: The c47-to-CSP bridge delta contains no root Cargo, dakia-core, fuzz, mail-parser, lettre, or core test-data path.
coreInputEquivalence.conclusion: The Rust core and vendored parser and SMTP inputs exercised by the c47 source run remain byte-identical. This does not carry forward a whole-source or native desktop result.

deepInputEquivalence.oracle: The deep entrypoints and their Cargo, dakia-core, fuzz corpus, fixture, and vendor inputs are unchanged from c47.
deepInputEquivalence.conclusion: The recorded c47 independent-server and bounded fuzz inputs remain byte-identical. This is not another deep execution.

performanceInputEquivalence.oracle: The performance runner, Cargo resolution, dakia-core implementation, and resilience and performance tests are unchanged from c47.
performanceInputEquivalence.conclusion: The recorded c47 mailbox-scale and resource-soak inputs remain byte-identical. Matching inputs does not prove identical timing, code generation, system load, or incremental-cache state.

storageCoverageInputEquivalence.conclusion: Every recorded root Cargo, dakia-core, mail-parser, and lettre input for the three separate storage coverage cohorts remains byte-identical.

dependencyAuditInputEquivalence.conclusion: The recorded root and fuzz locks, audit configuration, audit and provenance entrypoints, and all three vendored provenance declarations remain byte-identical. This does not rerun an audit.

limitations: This is path-and-content equivalence evidence. It does not rerun source, core, deep, fuzz, performance, coverage, audit, native, provider, or packaged-app lanes.

The final source is not wholly equivalent to c47 or LS-unavailable. The CSP bridge delta changes desktop CSP configuration, HTML rendering, Reader and identity-continuity tests, and privacy-boundary tests.
No earlier native, packaged-app, shared-profile, or live UI result is carried forward by this report.
The deep result retains its recorded bounded fuzz limits and temporal-safety limitation.
The performance result remains tied to its recorded hardware, build profile, and load conditions.
The storage result remains three separate focused cohorts. Branch observations are not aggregated into product or workspace coverage.
The dependency audit result retains its recorded allowed warnings and is not a fresh audit result.
